rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Build one measurable handoff from current template, bounded paths, tests and STOP conditions; save draft only.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Reject a handoff that claims merge authority absent from the scoped grant.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Group three observed findings by root cause, compare bounded options and justify one next decision.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Keep an unsupported completion claim UNKNOWN rather than promote it from self-report.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Reconcile one passed, one failed and one unobserved acceptance at the evidence cutoff.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Do not infer completion from a commit with no installed-behavior evidence.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Save an approved draft to a scratch destination, read exact bytes and report four distinct status classes.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Preserve same-name different-byte destination and refuse overwrite/release promotion.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Resolve a current family through independently authorized release chain with separate manifest/source commits.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Hold the Owner-conditional baseline AUTHORITY_UNVERIFIED; reject conflicting current releases.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Permit one read-only task with current governing sources and exact scoped paths/grant.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Hold missing source authority or an operation outside the grant.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Independently read tests and byte receipts, separate acceptance evidence from executor claims.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Reject a PASS claim whose evidence is absent or mismatched.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Copy one explicitly authorized new local file, read back bytes and recognize identical retry.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Preserve different bytes at an existing destination.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Choose one CHAT-allowed route supported by actual observed capabilities.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Hold missing pinned capability and do not silently switch Agent.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Transfer WIP, completed effects, next action and the frozen source lock without dispatch.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Refuse completed-dispatch replay or unreviewed source-lock rebind.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Trace a bounded requirement delta to acceptance and needed owning approvals; return draft assessment.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Hold a proposed canonical semantic change without owning approval.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Trace a supplied technical interface to owning BRD, data contract and executable acceptance evidence.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Report an unimplemented interface or missing BRD trace as a gap, never PASS.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Map a candidate identifier/path delta to actual consumers and prospective impact without mutation.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Hold semantic conflict with owning source; do not migrate Registry.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Verify one non-Bridge feature through installed behavior and acceptance evidence.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Block certification when only source code/unit assertions exist.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Read partial actual state and plan retries excluding already completed effects.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Hold uncertain execution/consumed dispatch instead of blind replay.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Reuse cutoff-bound health evidence to update a draft milestone view.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Do not create a competing master status from stale or unsupported facts.

rows.substantive_positive_scenario: Inspect method, data split, leakage, backtest and applicability limits; return bounded evidence tier.
rows.substantive_negative_scenario: Reject leakage/unsupported generalization and grant no deployment rights.
